name: Dragonmaw Base Camp, Shadowmoon Valley
shortDescription: The named camp where the Illidari papers, exalted summons, and final confrontation are staged in the TBC quest locators.
body: The named camp where the Illidari papers, exalted summons, and final confrontation are staged in the TBC quest locators. Story art and placements are interpretive; exact coordinates, routes, and layouts are not asserted.
